_comment: d9_t4096 (DRAFT, NOT SUBMITTED): d1_fast + long rows. Excluded from the draw, fail-closed: the heldout phase passes only if the full-set hits are exactly these ids (2026-10-06 local scan, 150,000 texts, 112 s).

perf_note: d1_fast = the D1 base cell (m2_first_cell_rwkv7.json) + the GPU-gated step fixes (job-2amiy, jobs/perf_step_gate rule perf_step_gate v1; stack/rwkv7/perf-step @953f3ac): row_plan min_cost 6.58 s/step (1.20x), + cont_plan single 6.11 (1.29x, peak 63 GB), + compile_blocks 5.63 (1.40x, peak 63 GB) vs greedy 7.89 on the same box. Loss within 1.9e-4 relative; gradient cosine 0.998 for every variant incl. pure regrouping, i.e. the GPU reduction-order floor (Agent A overrode the 0.999 bar on that evidence). Execution-only: not in the TrainConfig hash. Everything else, caps included, is D1; the same 190-min clock trains ~40 % more rows (time cap binds). Template for future cells.
execution_note: job-tvuat (jobs/cell_step_profile, rule v1-A2, PR #86 @54ee89d) ADOPT: chosen ckpt_rows_lean = per-block activation checkpointing keeping the cache fork, the step's 8 rows batched in length-sorted groups (<= 8 rows, <= 8,192 padded tokens per call; long rows split a step into several groups), chunked_lean WKV (our pure-PyTorch rearrangement of the vendored chunked WKV, CPU-equivalence-tested; no GPU gate needed); measured median step 8.25 s, 0 OOMs, projection 1,382 steps / 11,056 rows in 190 min (receipt receipts/2026-10-07-D-cell-step-profile-tvuat). Execution flags are not in the TrainConfig hash (same loss and gradients). rwkv7_wkv applies to both arms (child: run_cell / m2_gates; parent: score_parent). 'fla' only after jobs/fla_rwkv7 ADOPT + GPU_VERIFIED.
max_minutes_note: training wall-clock inside the 230-min cell phase: 230 - load/draw/tokenize ~10 - smoke+ladder ~10 - two dev cards ~10 - checkpoints/margin 10 = 190 (pre-registered); cumulative over restarts (train_clock in cell.json)
min_steps_note: exit 26 if the measured step time cannot reach 600 optimiser steps (4,800 rows) inside max_minutes: below that the cell is not a meaningful first measurement; re-price instead of spending the evals
lora_rank_note: M2_RUN_SPEC r=256 adds ~1.15B trainable params (~18 GB of fp32 weights + grads + Adam) on top of 26.5 GB bf16 weights and the un-checkpointed cache-fork activations; r=64 (the pilot's pre-registered rank) keeps the T=2048 ladder rung inside the 76 GB stop
train_max_k_note: D8/D9: K cap of the training items only (train.run_cell.train_max_k; cell_items default, also used by the m2_gates lineage rebuild); max_k 16 remains the eval cap. At T <= 4,096 the largest trained K is 151 (CLINC150).
row_options_note: execution guard (train.trainer.row_groups / single_cont_fits): <= 160 forked state copies per call (64 MB fp32 RWKV-7 state each); a step whose summed K exceeds 160 runs per group, so a K = 151 row runs alone or with K <= 9 rows. job-2amiy ladder: +3.67 GB per 40 copies (0.092 GB / copy at 16-token continuations; D9 continuations are <= 14 tokens).
single_tokens_note: execution guard (train.trainer.single_tokens_fit; not in the TrainConfig hash, same gradients, tests/test_cell_perf.py): cont_plan single only when the step's summed padded prefix tokens are <= 16,384, else the step runs per group. Numbers (job-2amiy ladder, 8 rows x K 10, 16-token conts, peaks in GB): per_group 1 x 8,192 tok / 80 copies 54.0; per_group 2 x 8,192 / 40 copies 50.3; single 2 x 8,192 / 80 copies 63.0, i.e. +9.0 GB per 8,192 retained tokens (1.10 MB / token) and +0.092 GB / copy. Uncapped single at T = 4,096 (8 rows x 4,096 = 32,768 padded, K <= 16 so <= 128 copies): 63.0 + 18.0 + 4.4 = 85.4 GB > the 76 GB stop. Capped: single <= 63.0 + 0.092 x (160 - 80) = 70.3 GB (worst, 160 copies); per_group fallback <= 54.0 + 0.092 x 80 = 61.3 GB (group <= 8,192 tok, <= 160 copies). d1_fast steps never exceed 8 x 2,048 = 16,384, so the cap never binds there. Cost: a 20,000-step simulation of random 8-row steps from the D9 census (min_cost plan, step-time fits on job-2amiy's 23 timed steps) puts 4.4 % of steps over the cap; mean step 8.92 s capped vs 8.91 uncapped vs 9.42 s with cont_plan per_group everywhere.
ladder_note: D9 ladder: the 4,096 rung's worst rows (run_cell sorts by K, then T) are 8 K = 151 rows of 3,073-4,096 tokens: summed K 1,208 > 160, so per_group, each row alone (<= 4,096 tok, 151 copies): est. <= 54.0 + 0.092 x 71 = 60.5 GB. T_max = 4,096 if that rung is ok and <= 76 GB; otherwise run_cell falls back to the largest fitting rung (2,048 = d1_fast + D8's K = 77 rows) and trains on.
rows_note: expected training: mean step ~8.9 s (vs d1_fast ~5.6 s on its 21,348 items, mean T 604.5 -> 1,049.4, padded tokens / step 6,758 -> 10,872) -> ~1,280 steps / ~10,200 rows in the 190-min clock (d1_fast model: ~2,030 steps / ~16,200 rows), ~0.39 epoch of the 26,085 items; time cap binds (max_steps 3,000 does not); min_steps 600 clears by ~2.1x.
